combination_events.en: Nine mechanism-boundary cases for automatic event lifetimes, returned/selected event handles, computed event controls, `iff`, deferred triggers and named-fork cleanup
combination_events.ja: 境界条件9件。自動変数のeventの寿命、戻り値・条件式で選択したevent、計算したイベント制御、`iff`、遅延トリガ、名前付きforkの終了処理を確認

combination_nba.en: Sixteen mechanism-boundary cases for delayed/event-controlled NBA through `ref static`, captured indices and values, string characters and array-slice copyback
combination_nba.ja: 境界条件16件。`ref static`経由の遅延・イベント制御付きNBA、値と添字の確定、文字列の文字要素、配列スライスのコピーアウトを確認

combination_aggregates.en: Eighteen mechanism-boundary cases for unpacked-structure references and lifetimes, array input copies, nested packed selections and streaming into strings/nested targets
combination_aggregates.ja: 境界条件18件。アンパック構造体の参照渡しと寿命、配列のinputコピー、ネストしたパック選択、文字列やネストした代入先へのストリーミングを確認

combination_io.en: Thirteen mechanism-boundary cases for `$fread` destinations and byte order, heap-backed implicit sensitivity and VCD contents read back inside SV
combination_io.ja: 境界条件13件。`$fread`の格納先とバイト順、キュー・動的配列の暗黙感度、SV内で読み戻したVCDの内容を確認

width_sign.en: Operands and targets of 63 to 1000 bits, signed and unsigned, with the operators whose result size and sign 11.6 to 11.8 decide
width_sign.ja: 63〜1000ビットの符号付き・符号なしのオペランドと代入先。11.6〜11.8が結果の幅と符号を決める演算子

xz_propagation.en: Operands with x and z bits for every operator of 11.4 that has rules for them
xz_propagation.ja: 11.4でx/zの規則が定まる各演算子について、x/zを含むオペランド

strength.en: Two drivers of a net with different strengths and values, on wire, tri, wand, triand, wor, trior, tri0 and tri1 nets and through bufif gates, shown with `%v`
strength.ja: 異なる強度と値を持つ二つのドライバ。wire・tri・wand・triand・wor・trior・tri0・tri1とbufifゲートを通し、`%v`で表示

wide_paths.en: Values of 63, 64, 65, 127, 128, 129 and 200 bits, 2-state and 4-state with x and z above bit 64, signed and unsigned, on the paths a value takes: assignments to wider, narrower and 2-state targets, part-selects and slices of packed arrays and writes to them, concatenation, replication, shifts past the width, comparisons and `?:` with an x condition, `$bits`, and function results, task inputs, output and ref arguments; shown with `%h`, `%b` and `%0d`
wide_paths.ja: 63・64・65・127・128・129・200ビット、2値・4値、64ビットより上のx/z、符号の有無。広い・狭い・2値の代入先、パック配列の部分選択・スライスと書き込み、連結・反復連結、幅を超えるシフト、比較、x条件の`?:`、`$bits`、関数結果、タスク入力、output・ref引数。`%h`・`%b`・`%0d`で表示

keywords.en: Illegal designs: each reserved keyword of IEEE 1800-2023 (Annex B) declared as a variable name under ``begin_keywords "1800-2023"``, and each keyword that a version of 22.14 adds declared so under ``begin_keywords`` of that version; a tool has to reject the declaration
keywords.ja: 不正な設計。附属書Bの各予約語を``begin_keywords "1800-2023"``の下で変数名として宣言し、22.14で各版が追加する予約語もその版の``begin_keywords``の下で宣言する。ツールは拒否する必要がある
